notes.title: Tao te ching annotations fix
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fix:[/b]
Due to changes in Ren'Py, ruby text was sometimes truncated when it was longer than the line of text it was adorning. This update restores the truncated text.

notes.title: Achievements fix
notes.notes:
We fixed the problem with Steam achievements not working, as reported by a couple of players.
If you previously satisfied the conditions to receive any achievements, but didn't unlock them, simply starting up the game should grant you all the missing achievements, provided that you still have your save data.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and extend our gratitude to the players who reported the issue.

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
It's been another year!

This update adds a new scenario with a new Taoist from the Touhou series, and another piece of historic literature for you to read in-game.
To access the new content, you need to play through the previous content. You may need to go through one dialog option in the "Further Studies" scenario to unlock the new scenario.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Anniversary Update[/h1]
It's been a year! To celebrate, we've released an update with new content. We're very excited about the new dialogue,  and hope you'll enjoy it.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[olist]
[*] A new study session, accessible through the main menu. To unlock, you need to finish the old study session. 
[*] Fixes typos and spelling mistake in the old dialogue.
[*] A few minor changes to the old dialogue to make it sound more natural.
[/olist]
